hunodan.criteria: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately.

weighted.method: Fresh automatic mask solves. Frames fixed before fitting. Checker strategy replaces the band; weighted strategy retains the original mask with zero band weights. Exported controls are independently rendered with resvg. Geometric and paper checks remain enabled. Variants swap both colours, translate by one source pixel in both axes with background fill, or alter only zero-weight pixels; the protected frame stays fixed.

referenceMethod.method: Both reference commits are served through the same local HTTP proxy with the current unchanged page, editor, worker and HiGHS vendor dependencies. Source bytes are read before timers. Fresh contexts upload each fixture independently.

invalidComparison.reason: Playwright routing did not replace Firefox worker imports. This purported previous-engine run contains LP mode and actually ran current runtime code. Its timings are not used as a previous-engine comparison.

experiments.method: Only direction integrality is removed. Fixed freshly prepared graphs; 2.5-second solve budget, first independently validated paper-feasible incumbent. Three alternating-order rounds.

Signed undirected commodity flow and degree bounds replace directed arcs. Fixed freshly prepared graphs; 2.5-second solve budget, first independently validated paper-feasible incumbent. Three alternating-order rounds.

Continuous relaxation of the original model; solutions must still pass original binary residual, geometry and paper checks. Fixed freshly prepared graphs; 2.5-second solve budget. Three alternating-order rounds.

phaseLP.method: Raw full LP objective probes on freshly prepared graphs; 0.5-second Node limit. Diagnostic only; not a release quality gate.

limitations: Browser timing is DOM readiness, not a paint timestamp. Artifact capture and file writing are excluded.

Old-reference repetitions run before current-reference repetitions, not in alternating order. Five observations per side establish these replay outcomes, not a universal speed or reliability guarantee.
Fresh timed optimization may select different valid checkpoints; unchanged acceptance gates do not imply per-pixel monotonic improvement. Every changed release error is recorded.
The 10-second Node measurement includes preparation, solving, validation and export, but excludes photograph decode and the separate independent SVG replay.
LP probes can fail or be fractional, and then consume part of the existing topology budget before normal MILP fallback. Integral results still require all original model, geometry and paper checks.
A probe has at most 0.5 seconds native solve allocation; model setup and required independent validation can finish after that timer.
Nominal geometry and paper-core checks have passed; physical cutting and assembly have not been tested.
